title: Invoicing and payment follow-up for freelance translators
topic: invoicing and payment follow-up tools for freelance translators
question: Which jobs in invoicing and chasing late payments are underserved for freelance translators, and which of them could a small agent-built SaaS serve?

picos.population: Freelance translators and interpreters who bill agencies and direct clients, often in several currencies
picos.intervention: Software for creating invoices, tracking payments and following up on late payments
picos.comparator: Generic invoicing SaaS, translation-management suites with billing modules, spreadsheets, invoice templates and manual reminder emails
picos.outcomes: Less time spent invoicing and chasing payments; fewer late or lost payments; correct per-word, per-hour, multi-currency and VAT handling
picos.setting: Web and mobile SaaS used by solo freelancers in Europe and North America; English-language public sources

in: invoice creation for translation and interpreting work (per word, per hour, minimum fees)
agency purchase-order matching and payment terms
multi-currency invoicing and VAT or sales-tax handling for solo freelancers
out: translation memory and computer-assisted translation features
full accounting or bookkeeping suites for companies with employees
payment processing infrastructure itself (card networks, banking licences)

include: Software product, community or directory relevant to invoicing or payment follow-up by freelancers
Publicly reachable product page or listing
Activity (release, changelog entry, post) inside the recency window
exclude: Products only for companies with an in-house finance team
Pages reachable only through excluded sources

unfair_advantages: Former freelance translator with access to two translator communities
